==Usage==
This template is used to generate dating citation reference notes for the installments of the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Academy]]'' series.

<pre><nowiki>{{JediAcademyDates|installment number}}</nowiki></pre>, where {{Para|installment number}} is a number from 1 to 9 corresponding to the books of the series.

#[[Jedi Academy (novel)|''Jedi Academy'']]
#''[[Jedi Academy: Return of the Padawan]]''
#''[[Jedi Academy: The Phantom Bully]]''
#''[[Jedi Academy: A New Class]]''
#''[[Jedi Academy: The Force Oversleeps]]
#''[[Jedi Academy: The Principal Strikes Back]]''
#''[[Jedi Academy: Revenge of the Sis]]''
#''[[Jedi Academy: Attack of the Furball]]''
#''[[Jedi Academy: At Last, Jedi]]''
